assets.caveat: March 2026 proposal envelope, not an approved or built outcome. Exact written heights and main floorplate dimensions; podium and rooftop screen traced from published plan vectors. Registration uses survey controls and existing-tower corners (allow ±1 m position, not a statistical confidence interval). Screen thickness, floor bands and materials are illustrative. Individual balconies, window divisions, recessed entries and equipment are omitted. Datum treated as local NAD83 UTM17; no sub-metre geodetic claim.
